rationale: Civil Engineering Technician supporting engineers on civil construction: drawing review, quantities, site inspections, QA records and as-built documentation.
Matches Marc's Philippines site work (inspections, quality checks, material records, progress reports) and Advanced Diploma earthworks, pavement and drainage design.
Perth based, so relocation would need discussion; advert asks for an experienced technician, which lowers the level score.
caution: Advert wants an experienced technician; Marc has about ten months of site work in the Philippines (2019 to 2020) and no Australian experience. Quantity take-offs are coursework only.
gaps: Not previously employed as a civil technician
Relocation to Perth would need discussion
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (quick apply with screening questions).
title: Civil Engineering Technician
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
